title: Measure rigidity for regular polynomial endomorphisms and applications
summary: We classify regular polynomial endomorphisms of $\mathbb C^k$ with the same equilibrium measure under some mild condition on the dynamics at infinity. In particular, for $f$ in a Zariski dense open subset of the parameter space and any $g$ of the same degree, $μ_g=μ_f$ if and only if $f=g$. We also establish finiteness results for maps with a prescribed equilibrium measure. Our approach rests on the stable manifold structure near the hyperplane at infinity. Applications include a Tits-type alternative, results on iterated centralizers, and an arithmetic non-density theorem.
